decision: Keep as the current statically validated bare-model candidate. Recover the last seed42-finishing FastCornerCarry baseline and add only bounded same-side steering retention during obstacle miss frames1--4. Do not claim that seeds11/17/21/42 are fixed, that completion or lap time improved, or that the candidate is submission-ready until an authorized fresh seed-by-track_id evaluation passes the stability-first gate.

failure_analysis.seed11_17_21: All three consumed runs were already near speed29--30 when steering unwound by the inherited0.07-per-frame slew and road visibility was lost after an obstacle pass into a continuing hairpin. A later unbound seed11 finisher held steering around-0.221 to-0.320 at the same progress instead of releasing to-0.027.
failure_analysis.seed42: On map fingerprint908e599dfe5a46e5, the02:26 run immediately after FastCornerCarry finished25.90s with zero collisions. The02:46 run after TranslationInvariantExit retired at progress0.378092 with five collisions, and the03:20 run after CoherentCurveAttack retired at the same progress with four collisions. The finisher began negative avoidance one progress tile earlier and reached that location only0.724 from centerline; the two failures were3.505 and4.207 away despite similar speed.
failure_analysis.contact_deadlock: The latest seed42 trace remained below speed0.3 for94 frames/7.52s while emitting approximately[-0.32,0.04,0], showing no dedicated low-speed contact escape state.
failure_analysis.causal_limit: Run timestamps and action signatures align with commit order but run files contain no source, agent, model or package hash. All four seeds are consumed adaptive evidence, not confirmation.

validation.independent_static_review: Independent audits separated the seed42 approach-line regression from the seed11/17/21 post-obstacle unwind, found the miss5 clearing boundary and sequential carryover contract defects, and required abrupt transition, preview-marker and reversal-boundary tests. Final re-audit found no blocking defect.

isolated_package.result: exact-file package/import/reset/action smoke passed; this is not an official Linux, driving or submission evaluation

residual_risks: No authorized driving run confirmed the candidate. Seed11/17/21 may require more than the base four-frame miss latch, while extending it without fresh tests could create new obstacle conflicts.
The compact obstacle detector discards components outside rows22--61 or above its size limits, and the inherited latch stores side/speed but does not replay lateral obstacle bias.
The inherited inside-obstacle arbitration can retain half the road-turn request against an opposing avoidance request; this single-factor candidate intentionally does not alter it.
There is no dedicated low-speed contact escape state, as exposed by the latest seed42 deadlock.
SOTA.md, RESULTS.md, COMPETITION_INFO.md, RESTRICTIONs.md and report.pdf remain absent, so new environment evaluation, promotion and submission remain blocked.
